prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: existing Silent Storm game UV texture atlas, resource 4656 M2_Element01_01.
Primary request: faithful high-definition restoration of THIS ENTIRE source texture. Edit the supplied opaque whole-RGB guide; it is the complete actual game-selected original, not a rendered scene. Improve fine material/paint detail while preserving the original image pixel coordinate layout.
Input image 1 is the WHOLE original RGB edit target. Input image 2 is the original alpha as a grayscale structural guide only, not part of the artwork. Output one complete opaque RGB atlas with the EXACT same aspect ratio/canvas, including original empty/black regions; source alpha will be restored offline.
Observed artwork: Two framed sepia figure illustrations side by side, thin nested straight frames, black gutters, small printed plaque under each. Preserve both exact poses and all original linework/marks; retain tiny print as matching strokes, invent no readable words.
Constraints: keep every UV island, boundary, silhouette, object count, panel, seam, crack, scale of brick/wood/fabric, mark and printed stroke at exactly the same normalized coordinates; preserve original palette, baked shadows and brightness relationships. Preserve any writing/logo identity EXACTLY, including orientation and spacing; do not invent or correct letters. Add only subpixel-level material detail; do not enlarge patterns. No reframing, no crop, no perspective, no re-layout, no added objects, no changed architecture, no new symbols, no new texture borders, no shadows outside original regions. This is a production texture, NOT a photograph of a surface and NOT a screenshot.
Return the complete map alone at high resolution, faithfully preserving its source composition. No labels or explanation.
Specific artistic repair: Highest priority over all enhancement suggestions: this texture contains authored printed artwork. Retain the original ink/letter pixels as the SAME SOFT STROKES, not readable or pseudo-readable reconstructed lettering. Do not typeset or sharpen glyphs into new characters. Copy exact source figure outlines and hatching, no invented armor rivets or anatomy. Improve only microscopic paper/wood grain; preserve source low contrast, source wear and original print softness. Treat the inked drawings and text as immutable decal content. No new stains, no added frame cracks, no extra decorative lines. Any recognisable new letter or invented line is a failure. Original image1 is the only edit target, do not reproduce earlier generation.
